name: Veerkrupa Jewellers Limited
summary: Veerkrupa Jewellers Limited is a retail enterprise specializing in precious adornments. Their extensive product line includes jewelry crafted from gold, silver, and platinum, often featuring diamonds and a variety of other precious and semi-precious gemstones. The company was founded by Chirag Arvind Shah and Neha Chiragbhai Shah on September 13, 2019, and maintains its headquarters in Ahmedabad, India.
